mapper.select:
SELECT mt.market_no, mt.market_title, DATE_FORMAT(mt.market_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS market_date, mt.market_writer, mt.view_count, mt.sell_addr, mt.sell_price, m.member_name,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_like_tbl ml WHERE ml.market_no = mt.market_no) AS like_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_report_tbl mr WHERE mr.market_no = mt.market_no) AS report_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_comment_tbl c WHERE c.market_no = mt.market_no) AS comment_count,
(SELECT member_thumb FROM member_tbl m2 WHERE m2.member_id = mt.market_writer) AS member_thumb,
( SELECT mf.market_file_path FROM market_file_tbl mf WHERE mf.market_no = mt.market_no ORDER BY mf.market_file_no ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS market_thumb,
( SELECT hex_code FROM color_tbl WHERE color_id = ( SELECT current_color_id FROM member_tbl WHERE member_id = mt.market_writer ) ) AS hex_code
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_like_tbl WHERE market_no = mt.market_no AND member_id = #{memberId}) AS is_like
FROM market_tbl mt JOIN member_tbl m ON mt.market_writer = m.member_id
WHERE market_status = #{status} AND completed = 0
AND ( #{location} = 0 OR sell_addr LIKE CONCAT('%', CASE #{location} WHEN 1 THEN '서울' WHEN 2 THEN '강원' WHEN 3 THEN '경기' WHEN 4 THEN '경남' WHEN 5 THEN '경북' WHEN 6 THEN '광주' WHEN 7 THEN '대구' WHEN 8 THEN '대전' WHEN 9 THEN '부산' WHEN 10 THEN '세종' WHEN 11 THEN '울산' WHEN 12 THEN '인천' WHEN 13 THEN '전남' WHEN 14 THEN '전북' WHEN 15 THEN '제주' WHEN 16 THEN '충남' WHEN 17 THEN '충북' END, '%') )
AND market_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND market_writer = #{searchKeyword}
ORDER BY market_no DESC ORDER BY market_no ASC ORDER BY view_count DESC ORDER BY like_count DESC ORDER BY sell_price DESC ORDER BY comment_count DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET ${page*size}

,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_like_tbl WHERE market_no = m.market_no AND member_id = #{memberId}) AS is_like
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_report_tbl WHERE market_no = m.market_no) AS report_count
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_report_tbl WHERE market_no = m.market_no AND member_id = #{memberId}) AS is_report
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_request_tbl WHERE market_no = m.market_no AND buyer_id = #{memberId}) AS is_request

mapper.select:
SELECT m.market_no, m.market_title, DATE_FORMAT(m.market_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS market_date, m.market_writer, m.view_count, m.sell_addr, m.sell_price, (SELECT member_name FROM member_tbl WHERE member_id = m.market_writer) AS member_name, ( SELECT mf.market_file_path FROM market_file_tbl mf WHERE mf.market_no = m.market_no ORDER BY mf.market_file_no ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS market_thumb, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_like_tbl ml WHERE ml.market_no = m.market_no) AS like_count
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_like_tbl ml2 WHERE ml2.market_no = m.market_no AND ml2.member_id = #{memberId}) AS is_like
FROM market_tbl m WHERE m.market_status = 1 AND m.completed = 0
AND m.sell_addr LIKE CONCAT(#{region}, '%')
ORDER BY m.market_no DESC
ORDER BY m.view_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM market_comment_tbl WHERE market_no = #{marketNo} AND market_recomment_no IS NULL
AND is_secret = 1
AND is_secret = 0

WITH RECURSIVE comment_tree AS ( SELECT * FROM market_comment_tbl WHERE market_comment_no IN ( SELECT market_comment_no FROM ( SELECT market_comment_no FROM market_comment_tbl WHERE market_no = #{marketNo} AND market_recomment_no IS NULL
AND is_secret = 1
AND is_secret = 0
ORDER BY market_comment_no ASC
ORDER BY market_comment_no DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET ${page*size} ) AS paged_parents ) UNION ALL SELECT c.* FROM market_comment_tbl c INNER JOIN comment_tree ct ON c.market_recomment_no = ct.market_comment_no ) SELECT t.market_comment_no, t.market_no, t.market_comment_writer, t.market_comment_content, DATE_FORMAT(t.market_comment_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS market_comment_date, t.market_recomment_no, t.is_secret, t.is_edited, m.member_name, m.member_thumb, ( SELECT hex_code FROM color_tbl WHERE color_id = ( SELECT current_color_id FROM member_tbl WHERE member_id = t.market_comment_writer ) ) AS hex_code FROM comment_tree t LEFT JOIN member_tbl m ON t.market_comment_writer = m.member_id
ORDER BY t.market_comment_no ASC
ORDER BY t.market_comment_no DESC
